item.title: Government researching childrens social media behaviour
item.description: Parliamentary Secretary Rebecca Buttigieg explains this is being done to ensure future policy decisions are fully informed by the specific realities of Maltese youth, rather than relying solely on international models

item.title: Government in talks with AUM over private water space
item.description: Parliamentary Secretary Glenn Bedingfield says he is 'confident that a deal will be reached so no one loses anything'

item.title: Polish girl who got swept out to sea in Ċirkewwa laid to rest
item.description: The death of Oliwia Wojnowska has shocked her hometown, as her funeral attracted crowds of mourners on Saturday

item.title: JD Vance booed at Winter Olympics opening ceremony
item.description: US Vice President JD Vance’s presence initially drew little reaction before boos intensified during the Parade of Nations

item.title: Elderly man grievously injured in mechanical plough accident
item.description: The accident happened at around 1pm in a field in Mġarr

item.title: Activists urge Malta to boycott Eurovision
item.description: The protest is a response to the European Broadcasting Union’s decision to permit Israel’s participation in the contest

item.title: The unruly kids of Sliema
item.description: An assault on Opposition MP Adrian Delia’s son has cast a spotlight on the anti-social behaviour of a group of teenagers that residents, visitors and business owners in Sliema’s shopping district face on a weekly basis

item.title: Marsa’s regeneration: Is it fourth time lucky?
item.description: The latest plans are the third such attempt by the Labour administration since 2013 to regenerate the inner part of the Grand Harbour, known locally as Il-Menqa and the fourth since 2007

item.title: A new chapter for a historic region
item.description: At the core of this massive regeneration project are the people, who will enjoy the best spaces and contribute value and quality to zones and sites that, for years, have needed attention

item.title: Rewarding illegality is an affront to fairness and basic decency
item.description: Unfortunately, the concept of fairness seems to fly over the Labour government’s head. The storm compensation ‘storm’ is but one of a series of decisions over the past years that undermine honest, ordinary citizens
